ATH_school_category = {
	ATH_school_of_hellas_goal = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_form_nation
		allowed = { original_tag = ATH }
		visible = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ATH_school_done }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ATH_TT_SCHOOL_WORKS check_variable = { ATH_works > 5.9 } }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ATH_TT_SCHOOL_LEAGUE check_variable = { ATH_league_size > 11.9 } }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ATH_TT_SCHOOL_WEST any_country = { OR = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } OR = { tag = CUM tag = POS tag = TAS tag = MET tag = KRO tag = LOK tag = RHE tag = SYR tag = GEL tag = AKR tag = ZAN tag = KAT tag = MAS tag = EMP tag = EPD tag = KRK } } }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ATH_TT_SCHOOL_PONTUS any_country = { OR = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } OR = { tag = OLB tag = TYS tag = PNT tag = ITR tag = APP tag = BYZ tag = HER tag = SNP } } }
			is_subject = no
		}
		fire_only_once = yes
		complete_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ATH_school_done
			add_ideas = ATH_school_of_hellas_goal_spirit
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = ante_victory_shown } } set_country_flag = ante_victory_shown news_event = { id = ante_victory.5 days = 1 } }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
